LanguageData.ARC.Tut.P1.Title: 1. Arcade machine
LanguageData.ARC.Tut.P1.Body:
One cabinet, a shelf of cartridges, and a coin slot that does not care which one you wanted.
You pick the difficulty. The machine picks the game - anything in the rec room that has an opponent, from the game of Ur to the punching bag. Whatever it lands on starts at the difficulty you chose, and the result goes on that game's record, not the cabinet's.
Install more furniture mods and the shelf gets longer.
